data.body_html:
Feria San Bernabé 2049 (11–15 June) turns Marbella into a non-stop fiesta of music, dancing, and celebration. And there's no better way to enjoy it than from the deck of a private boat. Our Marbella Feria San Bernabé boat party departs from Puerto Banús, giving you the perfect blend of glamour, sun, and sea. Whether you're celebrating with friends or family, we've got the right boat for you—prices start at €749 for 2 hours, all inclusive.

Why Choose a Boat Party for Feria San Bernabé?

The fair itself is buzzing, but it can get crowded. A boat party lets you escape the crowds and enjoy the Costa del Sol from a unique perspective. You'll cruise along the coast, anchor at a calm cove like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, and swim in crystal-clear water. Plus, you get your own private skipper and crew, so all you do is relax and have fun.

Our Feria Boat Party Fleet

We offer a range of boats to suit different group sizes and budgets. Here's a quick overview:

Feria San Bernabé 2049 Dates & Atmosphere

The fair runs from 11 to 15 June 2049. Expect daytime family fun and evening parties. The main fairground is at the Recinto Ferial, but the whole town gets involved. After your boat trip, you can join the festivities at the casetas or head to Puerto Banús for dinner and nightlife.

What's Included in Your Charter?

  • Licensed skipper (English & Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (chips, olives, nuts)
  • Insurance & safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

No hidden costs—everything's covered.

Popular Routes from Puerto Banús

Depending on the wind and your preferences, we can cruise west towards Estepona or east towards Cabopino. A classic route includes passing the famous Marbella skyline, stopping at Cala del Faro for a swim, and then heading back with views of La Concha mountain. For a longer trip, we can go as far as Sotogrande.

How to Book Your Feria Boat Party

Booking is simple. Contact us on WhatsApp with your preferred date and time. We'll confirm availability and send you a secure payment link. A 50% deposit secures your booking, with the balance due on the day. For groups larger than 12, we can arrange multiple boats or suggest the best option.

Don't wait—Feria week books out fast. Check our availability now.

Make It Special: Add-Ons

Want to elevate your party? We can arrange a DJ on board, a photographer, or a custom catering menu. For the Mangusta 80, a jet ski is included free for 20 minutes—perfect for adrenaline seekers. Just let us know your wishes when booking.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the Feria San Bernabé 2049?

Feria San Bernabé is Marbella's annual summer fair, held in June. In 2049 it runs from 11 to 15 June. Expect flamenco music, fairground rides, casetas (tented bars), and a lively atmosphere across the town. It's a great time to visit Marbella, and a boat party adds a unique twist to the celebrations.

How much does a boat party cost during Feria San Bernabé?

For a 2-hour charter, prices start at €749 on boats like the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39. For a 4-hour experience on the Mangusta 80, the price is €4,719, which includes a free jet ski. Other boats are available on request via WhatsApp—we'll tailor a quote to your group size and budget.

What's included in the boat party price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You don't pay anything extra on board—just bring your swimsuit and party spirit.

How many people can join a boat party?

Most of our yachts, like the Mangusta 80 and Ferretti 94, accommodate up to 12 passengers. Smaller boats, such as the Dubhe or Mariah SX21, take up to 5. For larger groups, we can arrange multiple boats or suggest the best option for your party size.

Where do the boats depart from?

All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, the glamorous marina in Marbella. You'll meet your skipper at the port, and we'll provide exact berth details after booking. Puerto Banús is easy to reach by car or taxi, and there's plenty of parking nearby.

Can we bring our own food and drinks?

Yes, you're welcome to bring your own food and additional drinks. However, we already provide a selection of beverages and snacks on board. If you have specific requests (e.g., a birthday cake or champagne), let us know in advance and we'll do our best to accommodate.

What happens if the weather is bad?

Your safety is our priority. If the captain deems conditions unsafe, we'll either reschedule your trip to another day or offer a full refund. We monitor forecasts closely and will keep you informed. In June, the weather in Marbella is usually sunny and calm.

How do I book a boat party for Feria San Bernabé?

Simply contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, time, and group size. We'll confirm availability and send you a booking link. A deposit secures your slot, with the balance due on the day. Book early—Feria week is extremely popular!

Ready to celebrate Feria San Bernabé 2049 in style? Browse our boats and reserve your party today. We look forward to welcoming you aboard!
